title: 5 high paying tech jobs that don't require coding

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Did you know you can earn six figures in tech without writing a single line of code?

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Remote work, AI, and automation are changing the job market faster than ever.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Tech roles like AI ethics officer are booming and don’t require coding skills.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: These jobs focus on shaping how AI is used — not building it.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Industries like healthcare and finance are hiring for these roles in record numbers.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The key is understanding AI’s impact — not being a developer.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Ready to explore which roles fit your skills? Follow for more.
